notes.title: Wishlist Cabernet on Steam now!
notes.notes:
After several years of work, we are so happy to announce our first full-length supernatural narrative RPG, Cabernet! 🦇 🩸 

We can't wait to hear your thoughts. And of course, don't forget to wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2401410/Cabernet/

[b]Change is brewing, threatening the established ways of alluring supernatural aristocrats. Sustain your facade as one of the living and struggle with your morality as a young vampire. Will you retain your humanity or descend further into the horror you have become?[/b]

Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in 19th century Eastern Europe. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Beware, the taste of Cabernet is not for the faint of heart - prepare to explore themes of social conflict, alcoholism, and corruption.

notes.title: "A Lozenge" is out now!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354100/A_Lozenge/

Hi all! Thank you so much for following us on our dev journey,

We are super excited to finally say that ​​"A Lozenge" is now released on Steam.

We've put a lot of heart in this game and really hope you enjoy it. Please let us know your thoughts in the comments on the game page - we'd love to hear from you!

[previewyoutube=6pU3o5SivFc;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Michelle is nauseous every car trip. A ginger lozenge may make her feel a little better, but this morning that’s a lot of pressure for a hard candy.[/i]

​“A Lozenge” is a short interactive story about motion sickness, dedicated to children of divorce. In the format of a 10-minute visual novel, it lets the player join Lucy and Michelle on their mother-daughter road trip.​

They will play as Lucy, a newly separated mother of a 9-year old, Michelle. They will hear Lucy’s thoughts, feel her doubts and anxieties and help her comfort her daughter by making occasional dialogue choices.​

“A Lozenge” is the third in Party for Introverts’ anthology of emotion-driven interactive short stories, along with “Thing-in-Itself” and “From Head to Toe”.

notes.title: Arrow keys controls alternative for Mac players
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35238703/46bf56df9db09b2bea503e196cf3d3491d602076.png[/img]

Hi, we've just made an updated version of "From Head to Toe" for Mac players who don't have a 2-button mouse. It allows to use Arrow Keys instead of LMB and RMB to progress in the game.

As always, thank you all for playing, and let us know your thoughts about the game in reviews and comments.

notes.title: AutoWalk mode added
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35238703/cf0e501a92bdc7a76645b100e237c913eec205ec.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone, we wanted to thank you for your reviews and feedback.

Based on some of the comments we decided to implement a new feature - AutoWalk mode - for those who just want to sit back and enjoy the story without the walking interaction. You can enable or disable it at nearly any point of the game by simply pressing the Space bar. Let us know what you think!
